_howto: Launchpad tour. Each step needs a unique id. To announce a NEW feature to users who already did this tour, ADD a step with a NEW id - they will see only that step as What's new. Rewording a step keeps its id (no re-show). To force a changed step to show again, give it a new id. target = list of CSS selectors, first visible one wins. fullOnly = only in the full tour, never counted as new. before/after = open or close menus (addClass / removeClass / click / call).
title: Launchpad tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to your Launchpad
steps.text:
This is your home screen. From here you open every module, find any screen, and manage your profile.

This quick tour shows you around. Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close it any time.

steps.title: Find any screen
steps.text:
Type what you are looking for, like leave, roster or payslip, and jump straight to that screen. Only screens you have access to are shown.

Point at the search bar without typing to see your most visited screens. Use the pin on a card to keep up to 5 favourites there.

steps.title: Your modules
steps.text:
Each tile opens a module. Tiles showing Enter Module are open to you.

A greyed-out tile showing Access Restricted means your company isn't licensed for it, or your role doesn't include it. Ask your administrator if you need access.

steps.title: Employee Master
steps.text: Add and maintain employees, departments, access roles, teams, leave and your organisation hierarchy. Employee changes here are sent to your clocking devices.

steps.title: Time & Attendance
steps.text: Clockings, timesheets, shifts and rosters, overtime approvals, violations, and all attendance reports.

steps.title: HR Management
steps.text: Infringements and warnings, performance notes, contracts and onboarding, and HR workflows.

steps.title: Fuel Management
steps.text: Fuel dispensing, vehicles and drivers, depots and tank levels, trip logs, deliveries and fuel reports.

steps.title: Production Pay
steps.text: Assign jobs, track progress, and report on production so it can be paid out.

steps.title: Asset Tagging & Stock Control
steps.text: Your asset register, movements and servicing, plus stock items, warehouses, GRVs and point of sale.

steps.title: Employee Costs
steps.text: Wage rates, cost components, monthly wage calculations, payfiles and bank files.

steps.title: ESS Master
steps.text: Set up Employee Self Service and handle what employees send in from the app, such as leave requests and expense claims.

steps.title: Contractors & Distribution
steps.text: Manage contractors, their contracts, distribution and progress, and send SMS broadcasts.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.text: The bell, top right, shows what is waiting for you, such as leave requests and profile updates from ESS. The red number is how many. Click one to open it in ESS Master; it disappears once it has been handled.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name to open your menu. Let's look at what's inside.

steps.title: Profile
steps.text: Your account: your name, role and when you last signed in. Update your name and email, see your employee record, or change your password on the Security tab. Saving any change asks for your current password, so nobody else can change your account.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Company-wide setup: company profile, users, roles and permissions, access zones, hardware, notifications and integrations. Only shown to users allowed to change settings.

steps.title: Access Control
steps.text: Opens Access Control for doors and access. It's only shown when your company is licensed for it and your role allows it.

steps.title: ESS (your own self service)
steps.text: Your personal Employee Self Service: apply for leave, submit expense claims, and view your payslips and documents.

steps.title: Connect a Phone
steps.text:
Shows a QR code that connects a company phone to your company. On the phone, open the app, tap the gear icon, then Scan with Camera.

The code contains your company licence key, so only show it while setting up phones.

steps.title: Download the App
steps.text: Shows a QR code to download the Android app straight onto a phone.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice is saved to your login, so it follows you to any computer.

steps.title: Logout
steps.text: Always log out on a shared computer. For safety, you are also logged out automatically after 15 minutes without activity.

steps.title: Privacy (POPIA)
steps.text: Read how your personal information is protected under the POPIA Act. You can also print it as a PDF.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: The ? next to your name replays this tour and lists the How-to guides, short walkthroughs on the real screen. When we add new features a green number appears on it; choose What's new to see only the new parts.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: That's the Launchpad. The other pages have a ? button too, with that page's tour and how-to guides.
